description: This file contains implementation of 2D convolution operations including forward, backward, and utility functions for CPU, specifically for convolutional neural network layers in PyTorch. It defines functions for computing input columns, shape checks, and low-level GEMM operations, as well as higher-level API functions for convolution forward and backward passes.
